title: Report check: taking control of a pawn leaning on a tavern wall (DPC 0.9.172-dev35)
intro: A player reported a crash when taking control of the main pawn in a tavern while he leaned against a wall. SAVE THE GAME FIRST: this may crash. Go into a tavern, playing the Arisen, co-op off. This test records what every pawn is doing (also to a flight file, so we keep it even if the game crashes).

probes.nodes: local pm = sdk.get_managed_singleton('app.PawnManager'); local l = pm and pm:call('get_PawnCharacterList'); if not l then return '' end; local t = {}; for i = 0, l:call('get_Count') - 1 do local c = l:call('get_Item', i); local ok, s = pcall(function() local f = c:call('get_ActionManager'):get_field('Fsm'); return tostring(f:call('getCurrentNodeName(System.UInt32)', 0)) .. ' | ' .. tostring(f:call('getCurrentNodeName(System.UInt32)', 1)) end); t[#t + 1] = (ok and s or '?') end; return table.concat(t, ' / ')
probes.dpc: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and (D.state.active and 'playing a pawn' or 'Arisen') or ''
probes.errs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json'); return ok and d and d.errors

steps.text: Get ready: saved, in a tavern. Press End.
Stand still near a wall until your main pawn leans on it (or sits, or poses). Takes a while sometimes. End once he's posing.
Now take control of your main pawn the usual way, while he's still posing. If the game crashes, just restart and tell Claude. Otherwise walk around a bit, then go back to the Arisen. End when done.

expect.label: who you play at the end

steps.text: Done. Tell Claude: crash or not, and what the pawn was doing.
